scope: Training-pool development prototype; no final test evaluation
model_selection: Mean composition-grouped training CV macro-F1; ties prefer logistic regression
feature_policy: Vinay's unchanged 21 descriptors with an explicit excerpt-duration text anchor
selection_proxy: Target-reference four-descriptor RMS distance + 0.25 * mean boundary bass jump / 12
strata: Melody notes/beat and harmonic-change rate plus seventh-chord fraction; median thresholds from fitting compositions only
final_test_access: Not implemented in this development command; final-readiness requires reviewed inputs and agreed splits
quality_claim: Classifier scores guide selection; they are not independent evidence of musical improvement
